questions.question: Who among the following Portuguese travellers visited the Vijayanagar empire during the reign of Krishnadevaraya?
questions.solution:
• Domingo Paes: Domingo Paes
  • Travelogue: He left a very vivid and detailed description of the city of Hampi (Vijayanagar).

questions.question: In 1905, Hindus and Muslims tied ‘Rakhi’ on each other’s hands to show their unity and their protest against the _________.
questions.solution:
• Rakhi Protest: Partition of Bengal
  • 1905: Suggested by Rabindranath Tagore, this symbol of 'Rakshabandhan' was used to show that administrative splits could not divide hearts.

questions.question: Who among the following social reformers established the ‘Prarthana Samaj’ in Bombay in 1876?
questions.solution:
• Prarthana Samaj Founder: Atmaram Pandurang
  • Detail: Founded in 1867 (the question mentions 1876, likely referring to its later organizational peak).

questions.question: Diwan-i-Am, containing the marble canopy ornamented with beautiful panels of pietra dura work, is a part of which monument?
questions.solution:
• Diwan-i-Am Pietra Dura: Red Fort
  • Shah Jahan: This exquisite stonework paneling is found behind the Emperor's throne in the Red Fort, Delhi.

questions.question: The Sun Temple at Konark, the Khajuraho Temple in Madhya Pradesh and the recently constructed Ram Temple in Ayodhya are examples of temples designed in which style of temple architecture?
questions.solution:
• Nagara Style: Nagara
  • Design: Characterized by the curvilinear 'Shikhara' tower; it is the dominant style of North Indian temples.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is/are true about the Iron Age?

1 The establishment of large cities took place on the basis of sizeable surplus.

2 The ceramic associated with this age was Painted Grey Ware.

3 The Indus Valley Civilization flourished during the Iron Age
questions.solution:
• Iron Age Statements: Only 1 and 2
  • Correction: The Indus Valley Civilization belonged to the Bronze Age, not the Iron Age.

questions.question: Which red and buff sandstone is the tallest tower in India built in the thirteenth century?
questions.solution:
• Qutub Minar: Qutub Minar
  • Stat: Standing at 73 meters, its construction was started by Aibak and finished by Iltutmish.

questions.question: Who among the following was the founder of 'Bhoodan Yajna' in India?
questions.solution:
• Bhoodan Yajna: Vinoba Bhave
  • 1951: Started in Pochampally (Telangana) as a voluntary land donation movement.

questions.question: Who among the following was a leader of Garam Dal, a group of radical nationalists?
questions.solution:
• Garam Dal Leader: Bipin Chandra Pal
  • TRIO: Part of the famous 'Lal-Bal-Pal' (Lala Lajpat Rai, Bal Gangadhar Tilak, and Bipin Chandra Pal).

questions.question: Who among the following founded a suburban township near Vijayanagara, called Nagalapuram, after his mother?
questions.solution:
• Nagalapuram: Krishna Deva Raya
  • Devotion: He founded this town near Hampi in honor of his mother, Nagala Devi.

questions.question: Who built Sudarshan lake in Junagarh?
questions.solution:
• Pushyagupta: Pushyagupta
  • History: He was a provincial governor under Chandragupta Maurya who constructed the dam of the lake.

questions.question: The construction of Humayun's tomb was completed by:
questions.solution:
• Humayun's Tomb Completion: Biga Begum
  • Fact: Also known as Haji Begum, she was Humayun's senior widow and supervised the project starting in 1565.

questions.question: Fa-Hsien, a Chinese Buddhist Pilgrim, began his journey back home (China) from ________.
questions.solution:
• Fa-Hsien's Return: Bengal
  • Journey: After spending years in Pataliputra, he took a ship from the port of Tamralipti (Bengal) to Sri Lanka and then China.

questions.question: The East India Company lost all its administrative powers with the enforcement of ___________.
questions.solution:
• End of EIC Power: The Government of India Act, 1858
  • Consequence: Following the 1857 Revolt, the British Crown took direct control of India.

questions.question: Sultan Ghari tomb is situated to west of the Qutub in Delhi is like a fortress within a walled enclosure with bastions on the comers, with its ____________ grave chamber underground.
questions.solution:
• Sultan Ghari: octagonal
  • Architecture: It is the first Islamic mausoleum in India (built by Iltutmish for his son Nasiruddin Mahmud).

questions.question: Andal was one of the most famous women ___________ saints.
questions.solution:
• Andal: Alvar
  • Saints: Alvars were Vishnu-worshipping saints, while Nayanars were Shiva-worshipping saints of Tamil Nadu.

questions.question: Sanchi stupa was rediscovered in the year ________ by General Henry Taylor.
questions.solution:
• Sanchi Rediscovery: 1818
  • Note: The stupa had been abandoned and overgrown with vegetation until General Taylor found it.

questions.question: When did Bindusara ascend the Maurya throne?
questions.solution:
• Bindusara's Ascension: 297 BCE
  • Succession: He succeeded his father, Chandragupta Maurya, and extended the empire towards the south.

questions.question: In which of the following cities of India was the first successful textile mill established?
questions.solution:
• Textile Mill (Mumbai): Mumbai
  • Industry: Formerly known as Bombay, it became the 'Manchester of the East'.

questions.question: Who built an elegant two-storey ‘ship palace’ between two reservoirs named Jahaaz Mahal?
questions.solution:
• Jahaaz Mahal: Sultan Ghiyasuddin Khilji
  • Location: Mandu, Madhya Pradesh. It is built to look like a ship floating on water.

questions.question: Who among the following founded the Servants of India Society in 1905 with the help of MG Ranade?
questions.solution:
• Servants of India Society: Gopal Krishna Gokhale
  • History: Founded in Pune in 1905 to promote social and educational services.

questions.question: Who was sent as an envoy to China during the time of Muhammad bin Tughluq?
questions.solution:
• Ibn Battuta: Ibn Battuta
  • Travels: The Moroccan traveler served as a Qazi in Delhi before being sent as an envoy to the Mongol court in China.

questions.question: What is the year of foundation of the Women’s Indian Association (WIA)?
questions.solution:
• WIA Foundation: 1917
  • Founders: Founded at Adyar by Annie Besant, Dorothy Jinarajadasa, and Margaret Cousins.

questions.question: Akbar’s first expedition towards Deccan was sent to Ahmednagar under the leadership of Prince Murad and _______________.
questions.solution:
• Expedition to Ahmednagar: Abdul Rahim Khan-i-Khanan
  • Siege: Prince Murad and Khan-i-Khanan led the forces against Chand Bibi in 1595.

questions.question:
Consider the following pairs:

1. Rajtaringini - Kalhan

2. Gita Govinda - Chandbardai

3. Vikramarjuna - Vijaya - Pampa

Which of the above paris is/are are correctly matched?
questions.solution:
• Correct Pair: Both 1 and 3
  • Correction: Gita Govinda was written by Jayadeva, not Chandbardai (who wrote Prithviraj Raso).
